WITH currency_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate != 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) as avg_rel_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) as benchmark_value
  FROM currency_stats
),
qualifying_currencies AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.avg_rebate,
    cs.avg_rel_gap,
    cs.avg_rebate - bc.benchmark_value as excess
  FROM currency_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc
  WHERE cs.avg_rebate > bc.benchmark_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_rebate) as mean_avg_rebate,
  AVG(avg_rel_gap) as mean_avg_rel_gap,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM qualifying_currencies
